set.body:
Implement LatentSketch and ReducedRankGls through typed controls instead of free-form engine_args. Reuse latent and multivar modules as algebraic backends. Model rank policy, basis source, sketch method, bootstrap/inference policy, and unsupported contrast boundaries explicitly.

Acceptance: engines lower through FitInterpreter; low-rank plans validate before execution; tests cover rank invalidity, OLS/GLS fallback equivalences on small cases, and fmrireg lowrank/rrr fixture parity where available.
set.title: Add latent sketch and reduced-rank GLS engines
